tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i sdom tshig bzhugs// ༄༅// rigs kyi khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis// sngon 'gro sbyangs nas mtshams gcad bya// gnas dang mchod pa byin phab nas// bdag bskyed mchod nas bzlas pa bya// bum pa gsal gdab mchod nas bzla// dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas byin gyis brlab// mchod bstod gtor ma rnams bdun gtang*// gtso mo'i bum steng mchod rten ni// ming byang bcas la kun tu dang*// dūr ba sngags dang bcas pas mchod// phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma phyogs nas gtang*// so so'i gtor bcas lha gzhan la// gsol ba btab nas slar yang mchod// byur bsal dug dbyung rnam gnyis bya// rgyal bar byed pas bslangs nas ni// gos sar rgyan gyis brgyan byas nas// dbang bskur don du gsol ba gdab// spyi bor bum bzhag sor 'brang gi /gzungs rings gnyis dang sngags gzhan gyis// dbang bskur nas ni sngags kyis bsrung*// bsrung 'khor gdags shing rdo rjes bsrung*// bden pa'i stobs kyis bsrung byas nas// sman nam zas la bden pa'i stobs// brjod nas mnga' dbul shis pa brjod// yon blang mchod bstod gshegs su gsol// dam pas bskul nas 'phags pas sbyar// //de nas yon gyi bdag pos maṇḍal phul la me tog bzung nas 'di skad ces/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ba re/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rig pa'i dbang bskur ba rdo rje'i go cha chen po'i phyag rgyas btab pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a dhi ṣṭhi te badzra swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog dang spos thogs la 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur la lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas spyi bor bum pa bzhag nas 'di skad ces/ na mo buddhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ na mo na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi satwa dharma saṃ ghe bhyaḥ

tadya thā/ oṃ bi pu la garbhe bi pu la bi ma le/ oṃ bi ma le garbhe/ bi ma le dza ya garbhe/ badzra dzwa la garbhe/ ga ti ga ha ni ga ga ne bi sho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ oṃ gu ṇa pa ti ga ga na bi tsā ri ni/ ga ga ri ṇi ga ga ri ṇi/ gi ri gi ri/ gi ri ṇi gi ri ṇi/ ga ma ri ga ma ri/ ga ma ni ra ga ma ni ra/ ga ha ri ga ha ri/ ga ha ga ha/ garga ri garga ri/ ga ga ri ga ga ri/ gambha ri gambhi ri/ ga bhi ga bhi/ ga hi ga hi/ ga ha ga ha/ ga ma ni ga ma ni/ ga re ga re/ gu ru gu ru/ gu bha gu bha/ gu ha gu ha/ gu ru gu ru/ gu ru ṇi gu ru ṇi/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsa le tsa le/ gu ha ṇi gu ha ṇi/ gu ru ṇi gu ru ṇi/ tsu lu tsu lu/ tsa le tsa le/ sa mu tsa le/ dza ye bi dza yai/ dza ye ba ti/ a pa rā dzi te/ sarba bha ya bi ga te/ garbha saṃ bha ra ṇi/ si ri si ri/ bi ri bi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ pi ri pi ri/ ṣi ri ṣi ri/ bha ga wa ti sa manta/ ā karṣa ṇi/ sarba sha trūṃ pra marda ni/ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ/ sarba satwā nāñtsa sarba dā/ sarba bha ye bhyaḥ sarba u pa dra be bhyaḥ sarba byā dhi bhyāḥ tsi ri tsi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bi ga ta a warṇi bi sho dha ni/ bi bi dha a ba ra ṇa bi nā sha ni mu ni mu ni/ mu tsi mu tsi/ mu li mu li/ tsi li tsi li/ ka ma le bi ma le na/ dza ya bi dza ya/ dza ya ba he dza ya ba ti/ bi she ṣa ba ti bha ga wā tī/ ratna ma ku ṭa/ ma la dha ri ba hu bi bi dha/ bi tsi tra be sha dha ri ṇi/ bha ga wa tī ma hā bidyā de bī rakṣa rakṣa māṃ/ sa pa ri wā ra sarba sa twāñtsa sa manta da sarba tra/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ hu ru hu ru/ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ/ sarba sa twāñtsa a nā tha/ na trā nā na la ya na/ nā ga shā ra ṇa pa ra ya ṇā na/ pa ri mo tsa ya sarba duḥkhe bhyaḥtsaṇḍi tsaṇḍi/ tsaṇṭe tsaṇṭe/ tsaṇḍi ni tsaṇḍi ni/ be ga wa ti sarba duṣṭa ni wā ri ṇi/ bi dza ya bā hi ni/

hu ru hu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tu ru tu ru/ ā yuḥpā la ni/ su ra ba ri/ pra ma tha ni/ sarba de wa ga ṇa pū dzi ti/ tsi ri tsi ri/ dhi ri dhi ri/ sa manta a ba lo ki te/ pra bhe pra bhe/ su pra bha wa bi shuddhe/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ dhu ru dhu ru/ dha ra ṇi/ dha re dha ra dha ra/ su mu su mu/ mu su mu su/ su mu ru su mu ru/ ru ru tsa le tsa la ya/ sarba duṣṭā na pū ra ya/ a shaṃ māṃ/ shrī wa su dhā re/ dza ya ka ma le/ kṣi ṇi kṣi ṇi/ ba ra da aṃ ku she oṃ padma bi shuddhe/ sho dha ya sho ddha ya/ shuddhe shuddhe/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ maṃ ga la bi shuddhe/ pa wi tra mu khi/ khaḍgi ni khaḍgi ni/ kha ra kha ra/ dza li ta shi ta shi kha re/ sa manta a ba lo ki te pra bhe su pra bi shuddhe/ sa manta pra shā ri ta a ba bhā ṣi ta shuddhe/ dzwa la dzwa la/ sarba de wa ga ṇa gra ha na kṣa tra/ sa ma ā karṣa ni/ sa dya pra te/ oṃ hrī trāṃ tā ra tā ra/ tā ra ya tā ra ya māṃ/ bha ga ba ti sarba satwāñtsa/ nā ga bi lo ki te/ la hu la hu/ hu lu hu lu/ hu ru hu ru/ laghu la ghu/ tu hu tu hu/ tu ru tu ru/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ kṣi ṇi kṣi ṇi/ hu ṇi hu ṇi/ sarba gra ha bha kṣa ṇi/ piṃ ga li piṃ ga li/ mu tsu mu tsu/ su mu su mu/ su bi tsa ri/ ta ra ta ra/ nā ga bi lo ki tā ra ya māṃ/ sarba satwāñtsa sansā rā/ arṇaṇa tā/ bha ga wa tī aṣṭa ma hā dā ru ṇa/ bha ye bhyaḥ sarba tra sa mante na di sha bandhe na/ badzra prā kā ra/ badzra pā sha bandhe na tsa/ badzra dzwa lā bi shuddhe/ bhu ri bhu ri/ bha ga wa tī garbha bi sho dha ni/ ku kṣi saṃ pū ra ṇi/ dzwa la dzwa la/ tsa la tsa la/ dzwa la ni dzwa la ni/ barṣa tu te wa sa mante na da byi u da ke na/ a mṛ te barṣa ṇi/ de wa tā a wa tā ra ṇi a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ su ga ta ba ra ba tsa na a mṛ ta pa ra su ṣe rakṣa rakṣa bha ga ba tī māṃ/ sarba tra sarba dā/

sarba bha ye bhyaḥ sarba u pa dra be bhyaḥ sarba u pa sargeg bhyaḥ sarba byā dhi bhyaḥ sarba duṣṭa bha ya bhī te bhyaḥ sarba ki li ka la ha/ bi gra ha bi bā dā dursawapna durmitta/ a maṃ ga la pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa na ga bī dā ra ṇa/ tsa la tsa la/ ba la ba la/ ba la wa ti dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ dza ya tu māṃ/ sarba tra sarba ka li siddhyantu me i ma ma ma hā bidyā sā dha ya maṇḍa laṃ sā dha ya sa manta na/ ghā ta ya bighnān/ dza ya dza ya/ siddhye siddhye/ buddhya buddhya/ siddha siddha/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/ pū ra ṇi pū ra ṇi/ sū ra ya me ā shān/ sarba bi dyā uṅga ta mūrti/ dza yorṇa te dza ya ba hi ni dza ya ba ti/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ bha ga ba tī/ sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ shuddhe bya ba lo ka ya māṃ sa pa ri wā raṃ sarba satwāñtsa aṣṭa ma hā dā ra ṇa bha ye shu sarba a shi pa ri pū ra ya/ tra ya swa ma hā ba ya bhyaḥ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sarba a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni/ sa manta ā ka ra maṇḍa la bi shuddhe/ bi ga te bi ga te ma le/ sarba ma la bi sho dha ni/ sarba maṃ ga la bi shuddhe/ sarba a maṃ ga li bi sho dha ni/ kṣi ṇi kṣi ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi shuddhe ma la bi ga ti/ dza ya ba ti te dzo ba ti/ badzre badzra ba ti trai lo kya a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta mūrdha a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba buddha bo dhi satwa a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya shuddhe swā hā/ sarba de wa tā a bhi ṣe kaiḥswā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a dhiṣṭhi te hṛ da ya swā hā/ sarba thā ga ta hṛ da ya siddhe swā hā/ ind+re ind+ra ba ti ind+ra bya ba lo ki te swā hā/ brahme brahma dhu ṣi te swā hā/ biṣṇu na maskṛ tā ya swā hā/ ma he shwa ra bandi ta pū dzi ta ye swā hā/ badzra dha ra ya badzra pā ṇi pa la bidyā a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ dhṛ ta rāṣṭā ya swā hā/

bi rū ṭa kā ya swā hā/ bi rū pakṣa ye swā hā/ bai shra wa ṇā ya swā hā/ tsa turma hā rā dza na maskri tā ya swā hā/ ya mā ya swā hā/ ya ma pū dzi ta na maskri tā ya swā hā/ ba ru ṇā ya swā hā/ ma ru tā ya swā hā/ ma hā ma ru tā ya swā hā/ agna ye swā hā/ wā ya be swā hā/ nā ga bi lo ki tā ya swā hā/ de wa ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ nā ga ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ yakṣa ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ rakṣa sa ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ gandharba ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ a pa sā ra ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ a su ra ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ ga ru ḍa ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ kinna ra ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ ma ho ra ga ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ ma nu ṣya ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ a ma nu ṣya ga ṇe bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba gra he bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba bhū te bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba pre te bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba pi shā tse bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba unmā de bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba a pa smā re bhyaḥswā hā// sarba kumbhaṇḍi bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba pū ta ne bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba ka ṭa pū ta ne bhyaḥswā hā/ sarba duṣṭa pra duṣṭe bhyaḥswā hā/ oṃ dhu ru dhu ru swā hā/ oṃ tu ru tu ru swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru swā hā/ oṃ mu ru mu ru swā hā/ oṃ ha na ha na sarba sha trūṃ swā hā/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba duṣṭā na swā hā/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pra tyaṃ arthi kā pra tya a mi trā na swā hā/ ye ma ma a hi ta e ṣā na sarba te ṣa na shī ri raṃ dzwa la ya dzwa la ya swā hā/ sarba duṣṭāṃ tsitta nā na swā hā/ dzwa li ta ye swā hā/ pra dzwa li tā ya swā hā/ dī pa dzwa lā ya swā hā/ badzra dzwa lā ya swā hā/ agna ye dzwa lā ya swā hā/ sa manta dzwa lā ya swā hā/ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ pūrṇaṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ sa manta bha drā ya swā hā/ ma hā sa manta bha drā ya swā hā/ kā lā ya swā hā/ mahā kā lā ya swā hā/ ma trī ga ṇā ya swā hā/ yakṣa ṇī nāṃ swā hā/

rakṣa sa nī nāṃ swā hā/ pre ta pi shā tsa ḍā ki nī nāṃ swā hā/ ā kā shā ma trī nāṃ swā hā/ sa mu dra ga mi nī nāṃ swā hā/ sa mu dra bā si ṇī nāṃ swā hā/ rā tri tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ di wā pa tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ trā sandhya tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ be lā tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ i be la tsa rā ṇāṃ swā hā/ garba ha re bhyaḥswā hā/ garba hi ri ṇī bhyaḥswā hā/ garba sandha ra ṇī swā hā/ hu lu hu lu swā hā/ tsu lu tsu lu swā hā/ oṃ swā hā/ swa swā hā/ bhu swā hā/ bhu wa swā hā/ oṃ bhurbhu wa swā hā/ tsi li tsi li swā hā/ tsi ṭi tsi ṭi swā hā/ bi ṭi bi ṭi swā hā/ dhā ri ṇi swā hā/ agni swā hā/ te dzwa wa pū swā hā/ tsi li tsi li swā hā/ mi li mi li swā hā/ si li si li swā hā/ buddhya buddhya swā hā/ siddhya siddhya swā hā/ maṇḍa la bandhe swā hā/ si mā bandhe swā hā/ sarba sha trūṃ bhañdza ya bhañdza ya swā hā/ dzambha ya dzambha ya swā hā/ st+wambha ya st+wambha ya swā hā/ tstshinda tstshinda swā hā/ bhinda bhinda swā hā/ bhañdza bhañdza swā hā/ dzambha ya dzambha ya swā hā/ st+wambha ya st+wambha ya swā hā/ bandha bandha swā hā/ mo ha ya mo ha ya swā hā/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya swā hā/ ma ṇi bi shuddhe swā hā/ sūrya sūrya bi shuddhe swā hā/ sho dha ni bi sho dha ni swā hā/ tsand+re tsand+re swā hā/ pūrṇaṇa tsand+re swā hā/ gra he bhyaḥswā hā/ nakṣa tre bhyaḥswā hā/ pi shā tse bhyaḥswā hā/ bi shwa bhyaḥswā hā/ shi bebhyaḥswā hā/ shānti bhyaḥswā hā/ puṣṭi bhyaḥswā hā/ swast+ya ni bhyaḥswā hā/ shi baṃ ka ri swā hā/ shaṃ ka ri swā hā/ shānti ka ri swā hā/ puṣṭi ka ri swā hā/ ba la brtā ni swā hā/ ba la barbhi ni ka ri swā hā/ shrī ka ri swā hā/ shrī bardha ni swā hā/ shrī dzwa la ni swā hā/ mu tsi swā hā/ na mu tsi swā hā/ ma ru tsi swā hā/

be ga ba ti swā hā/ oṃ ta thā ga te mūrti/ pra ba ri bi ga ta bha ye swa ma ye swa me bha ga ba tī/ sarba sā sti ra bha wa tu ma ma sarba satwā nāñtsa swā hā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni/ bi mu ni bi mu ni/ ba ri tsi ri tsa lo ni/ bha ga ba ti dza ya bi ga ti bha ya ha ri ṇi/ bo dhi bo dhi/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ buddhi li buddhi li/ tsumbhi li tsumbhi li/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya dzuṣṭhi swā hā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni/ mu ni wa re a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba bidyā a bhi ṣe kairma hā badzra ka pa tsa/ mu dri mu dri tī/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya a dhiṣṭhi te badzrā ya swā hā/ dbang bskur ba ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //tadya thā/ oṃ gi ri gi ri/ gi ri ṇi gi ri ba ti/ gu ṇa ba te/ ā kā sha ba ti/ ā kā sha bi shuddhe/ sarba pā paṃ bi ga te/ ā kā she ga ga na ta le/ ā kā sha bi tsa ra ṇi dzwa li ta shi kha re/ ma ṇi mukte kha tsi ta mau li dha re/ su ke she/ su bakt+re/ su ne tre su barṇa gau rī a tī te/ a nutpanne/ a nā ga te/ pra tatyūtpanne/ na maḥsarba ṣā na buddhā nā na/ dzwa li ta te tsa sā na/ buddhe su buddhe/ bha ga wa tī/ su rakṣa ni su kṣa me/ su pra bhe/ su dha me/ su dānte/ ba re bha ga wa tī/ bha dra ba ti/ bha dre/ su bha dre/ bi ma le/ dza ya bha dre/ tsaṇḍe tsaṇḍe/ pra tsaṇḍe pra tsaṇḍe/ badzra tsaṇḍe/ ma hā tsaṇḍe/ gau rī/ gandha rī/ gau rī/ tsau rī/ tsaṇḍā lī/ mā taṅgi/ ba tsa si/ pukka si/ su ma ti/ sha ba rī/ shaṅka ri/ drā mi ḍi/ rau tri ni/ sarba artha sā dha ni/ ha na ha na/ sarba sha trūṃ/ da ha da ha/ sarba duṣṭān/ pre ta pi shā tsa/ ḍā ki nī nā na/ ma nu ṣya/ a ma nu ṣya nāñtsa/ pa tsa pa tsa hṛ da yan/ gdon ma rungs pa rnams kyi srog gzhom du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag gi sdig pa thams cad gzhig tu gsol/ gzhig tu gsol/ thams cad du 'jigs pa dang*/ gdon thams cad las bdag la bsrung du gsol/

bsrung du gsol/ ma rungs pa thams cad bcing du gsol/ sarba ki la bi ṣa nā sha ni/ marta daṇḍi/ mā ni ni mā ni ni/ tsa le tsa le/ tsi ti tsi ti/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ti ṭi ni/ tu ṭe/ gau rī ni/ bīrya ni/ pra ba ra sa ma re/ tsand+rā lī/ ma taṅgi/ ru dha si/ brtsa si/ su ma ti/ a ma ri/ su mu ri/ pukka sī/ sha ba rī/ sha ma ri/ shaṅka ri/ drā mi ḍi/ da ha ni/ pa tsa ni/ ma tha ni/ marda ni/ sa ra le sa ra le/ sa ra laṃ bha bhi na ma dyotk+riṣṭa/ bi dhā ra ṇi/ ma hi li/ ma ho ma hi li ni ga ḍe/ ni ga ḍa/ bhañdze/ matti matti/ ni matte/ tsakra bā gi ni/ dzwa la dzwa le/ dzwa le dzu le/ sha ba ri sha ba ri/ shā ba ri shā ba ri/ sarba byā dhi ha ra ṇi/ tsū ḍi tsū ḍi tsū ḍi ni/ tsū ḍa ma ṇi/ ni mi ni mi/ ni mindha ri/ tri lo ka dza hi ni/ tri lo ka ā lo ka kā ri/ trai dhā tu ka bya ba lo ki ni/ badzra pā ra shu/ pā sha mutka ra/ khaḍga shaṅkha tsakra tri shū la/ tsintā ma ṇi/ ma hā bidyā dha ri ṇi/ bdag thams cad du gnas thams cad na gnas pa na ma rungs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ nad thams cad dang*/ 'jigs pa thams cad las bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol lo// badzra badzra ba ti/ badzra pā ṇi dha re/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ tsi li tsi li/ tsi mi li tsi mi li/ si li si li/ pi li pi li/ ba ra ba ra ba ra de/ sarba tra dza ya/ labdhe swā hā/ sarba pā pa bi dā ri ṇi swā hā/ sarba tra sarba byā dhi ha ra ṇi swā hā/ sarba tra sarba bha ya ha ra ṇi swā hā/ sambha ra ṇi swā hā/ swastir bha ba tu māṃ swā hā/ shānti swā hā/ puṣṭi swā hā/ dza ya tu dza ye dza ye swā hā/ dza ya ba ti/ dza ya bi ma le/ bi pu le swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta murti swā hā/ oṃ bhu ri bhu ri badzra pa ti/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ pū ri ṇi/ sandha ri ṇi/ ba la ba la/ dza ya bīrye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dbang bskur ba'i gzungs phyi ma ste bcu gsum pa'o//

//bden pa dang bden pa'i mchog gang gis/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas pa'i tshig bden pa rnams dang*/ 'jig rten gyi tshig gi mchog dang*/ dge sbyong rnams kyi nang na dge sbyong skyid de ba zhes bya ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 'jigs pa mi mnga' ba/ bag tsha ba mi mnga' ba ste/ mi skrag mi 'bros la 'jigs pa med cing*/ 'jigs pa dang*/ 'jigs par byed pa dang bral ba/ 'jigs pa dang*/ 'jigs par byed pa spangs pa/ skyi bur zhes byed pa med pa'o// zhes yang dag par smra bas smra ba ni/ dus su yang dag par smra bas smra ba yin te/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis tshul khrims dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ dka' thub dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa gang ci yang rung ba de dag gi nang na ni/ 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig gnas brtan rgyal po'i bu thu bo dang 'dra ba rab tu byung nas ring du lon pa tshangs par spyod pa mngon par spyad pa rnams kyi mchog 'di lta ste/ dge slong kun shes kauṇḍi n+ya dang*/ 'dod pa nyung ba dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa dang*/ chog shes pa rnams kyi mchog 'od srungs chen po dang*/ shes rab che ba dang*/ spobs pa che ba rnams kyi mchog sha ra dwa ti'i bu dang*/ rdzu 'phrul che ba dang*/ mthu che ba rnams kyi mchog maung gal gyi bu chen po dang*/ lha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog ma 'gags pa dang*/ mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog kun dga' bo dang*/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog nye ba 'khor dang*/ chos smra ba rnams kyi mchog byams ma'i bu gang po dang*/ bslab pa la gus pa rnams kyi mchog sgra gcan 'dzin dang*/ mal cha dang stan bsko ba rnams kyi mchog gyad bu nor dang*/

seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa rnams kyi mchog ba ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len dang*/ khyim bdag dang dad pa bskyed pa rnams kyi mchog nag po chen po 'char ka dang*/ lha dang mis mchod pa rnams kyi mchog legs mthong gi bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o// rgyal po'am/ chom rkun nam/ me'am/ chu'am/ dgra'am/ mi mdza' ba'am/ lam du 'gro ba'am/ lam log par 'gro ba'am/ gnyid log pa'am/ ra ro ba'am/ bag med pa thams cad las bsrung bar bya'o// bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis sems can rkang pa med pa'am/ rkang gnyis pa'am/ rkang bzhi pa'am/ rkang mangs sam/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes can nam/ 'du shes med pa'am/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi sems can ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o// bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis 'dus byas sam/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni 'dod chags dang bral ba mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o// bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ tshogs sam/ 'dus pa'am/ mang po'am/ 'khor ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des/ rgyal khams sam/ yul 'khor ram/ grong ngam/ grong rdal lam/ grong khyer ram/

khyim mam/ nags sam/ zhing ngam/ nad pa 'di la bsrung bar bya'o// yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ mtshams gcad par bya'o// 'byung po thams cad bzlog par bya'o// gzi byin 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bya'o// bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngas 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug zad par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan pa dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ brjod pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zad par gyur cig med par gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ bden pa'i stobs kyis bsrung ba ste bcu bzhi pa'o// nad pa'i zas dang*/ skom dang*/ sman rnams kyang reg sngags 'dis btab ste stsal bar bgyi'o// rdzogs sangs rnam par sangs rgyas tshe// 'jig rten skyong bas phyogs bzhi nas// snod bzhi dag ni blangs nas su// bde bar gshegs la phul ba dang*// mthu yis gcig tu sprul mdzad pa// lha yi snod mchog de dang ni// bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams// ston pa'i phyag na bsnams gyur pa// bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /de bzhin lha mo 'phrog ma yis// lha rdzas dge ba a ru ra// blangs nas ston la rab phul ba// bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams// bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis// nad pa rnams kyi nad sel cing*// nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang*// gtsug tor can gyi stobs rnams dang*// thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang*// log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang*// gser zhes bya ba'i ye shes dang*// 'od srungs kyi ni rdzu 'phrul dang*// shākya seng ge'i mthu rnams kyis// sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog

/nad pa shar phyogs kha bstan la// sman rnams nye bar stsal bar bgyi// de yi tshe na rig sngags 'di// lag mthil bzhag ste bklag par bgyi// syādya the dan/ kha ṭe kha ṭe/ kha ṭa bi kha ṭe/ tsa le bi tsa le/ bi laṃ be/ ba le ba la ba te/ tsant+ri/ tsa ra ṇe/ a mṛ ta nirgho ṣe swā hā/ rlung las gyur dang mkhris las gyur// bad kan las gyur 'dus las gyur// nad rnams thams cad rab bcom ste// bdag la rtag tu bde legs shog /bram ze rnams kyis bslus nas su// shākya seng ge skyob pa la// dpal sbas kyis ni dug can gyi// bsod snyoms dag ni phul ba dang*// de las de ni blangs nas su// ston pas dug ni bsad nas gsol// bden pa'i tshig ni 'di yis su// zas ni bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /rnam par gzigs dang lha gang dang*// gtsug tor can dang kun skyob dang*// log par dad pa sel ba dang*// stobs chen lha gang dad pa dang*// gser dang dpal ldan 'od srungs dang*// shākya yi ni seng ge la// rab dad lha yi dbang po dang*// tshangs dbang sum cu'i dbang phyug dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dag dang*// nor bu bzang dang dbang phyug che// srin mo nag mo chen mo dang*// de bzhin gdol mo gtum mo dag /me tog dang ni bdug pa dang*// bdag gi sbyin sreg 'di bzhes shig /de dag tshim zhing mchod gyur nas// bdag gi kha zas byang bar mdzod// zas lnga dag dang 'dres pa yang*// bdag la ma 'dres mdzad du gsol// kha zas lnga dang 'dres pa yang*// zas de kun ni bza' bar bgyi// sa bon dag gi tshogs kun la// sa yi bcud ni zhugs pa yi// kha zas 'dres pa thams cad kyang*// bdag la ma 'dres mdzad du gsol// ji ltar skud pa bcad bsregs kyang*// de lta bur yang slar 'byor pa// de ltar zas rnams 'dres pa yang*// ma 'dres par ni bdag la mdzod// syādya the dan/ kha kha me/ kha kha/ kha kha/ khu me/ shi shi me/ shi hu me/

shi ma shi me/ swa sti/ swa sti/ swa sti/ swa sti/ ma ma shānti/ shānta/ sha ra gri/ kha zas lnga dang 'dres pa yang*// ji ltar ma 'dres zas bzhin du// bdag gis ji ltar skud bsregs pa// de 'dra'i bden pa mdzad du gsol// syādya the dan/ ka la li/ ka la le/ ka la le/ khu khu me/ agni/ saṃ gra ma ni swā hā/ sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs dang sangs rgyas gtsug tor can// bde gshegs kun skyob sangs rgyas log par dad sel dang*// gser thub 'od srungs shākya thub pa gau ta mya// bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba la skyabs su mchi bar bgyi// mi mchog bdun po de dag gi ni sku rnams la// me tog dag dang spos rnams kyis ni mchod par bgyi// lus dang yid kyang rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis ni// de dag rnams la skyabs su nye bar mchi bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che dang ldan pa de dag la// lha gang mngon par rab tu dang ba yod pa yi// lha de mgu zhing yid ni rab tu dga' 'gyur nas// rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bdag la bsrung du gsol// 'jig rten 'di'am yang na 'das pa dang*// mtho ris dag na rin chen mchog yod pa'ang*// de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi lhar gyur pa// mi yi mchog dang 'dir ni mtshungs pa med// de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /zad pa chags bral bdud rtsi 'dus ma byas// shes pas shākya thub de rab tu phye// bdud rtsi zhi ba 'dus byas ma yin pa// chos de dang ni mtshungs pa gang yang med// de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /mchog tu gang 'dod tshul bzhin rab bstan pa// ston pa'i rnal 'byor bla med rtag bsgrub pa// rdo rje lta bu mi gnyis lam mthong ba// ting 'dzin de dang mnyam pa yod ma yin// de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog

/gang zag chen po brgyad po rab bsngags shing*// gang zag zung bzhir brjod pa de dag ni// drang srong chen po gang zag mtshungs med pa// bde bar gshegs pas sbyin pa'i gnas shes gsungs// de la byin na 'bras bu cher 'byung ste// zhing rab gshin la sa bon btab pa bzhin// 'di ni dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /gang dag brtan pa'i yid kyis rab brtson zhing*// gau ta ma'i bstan la 'jug byed pa// de dag thob nas bdud rtsi 'jug thob ste// mun pa bsal nas mya ngan 'das thob pa// de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /lta ba 'di la sbyar ma thag tu ni// 'jig tshogs lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang*// the tshom dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag /cig car spangs te 'phags pa'i bden mthong ba// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni mchog thob shog /lus sam ngag gam 'on te yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa rnam gsum nam yang mi byed la// glo bur byas na'ang 'chab par mi byed cing*// de ltar de dag lta bas 'dzin mi byed// de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /ji ltar dbang po'i sdong po sar btsugs pa// phyogs bzhi'i rlung rnams kyis ni mi g.yo ltar// 'phags pa'i lam gyi dam pa mthong ba yi// gang zag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun de bzhin no// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /shes rab zab mos shin tu bstan pa yis// 'phags pa'i bden pa su dag rnam bsgom zhing*// lus kyang sbyin par yid la byas pa ni// de dag 'jigs pa brgyad dang 'phrad mi 'gyur// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog

/ji ltar me ni rlung gis rab gtor ba// lag tu blangs te bgrang du med pa nyid// de ltar kun du sbyor ba rab btang ba// sangs rgyas sras rnams bstan du med par 'gro// des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /ston mchog lha dang mi yis mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te// sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*// skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*// nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod gyur cig /'di ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis// shin tu bden pa gsungs shing brdzun med pa// bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /de kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig swā hā/ shis pa brjod pa ste bco lnga pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
